decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - Within one month of the date of this permission, a method statement detailing the remedial work to reduce the inappropriate profile of the weather-struck jointing that has been carried out shall be submitted to, and approved, by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme within 2 months of the date of the approval.
description: Following approval for conversion and alterations of existing building into offices and two 1 bedroom houses, one 2 bedroom house, one 3 bedroom house.
